fields.name: Payload container type value
fields.description: Payload container type value: 0001=N1 SM information, 0010=SMS, 0011=LTE Positioning Protocol (LPP) message container, 0100=SOR transparent container, 0101=UE policy container, 0110=UE parameters update transparent container, 0111=Location services message container, 1000=CIoT user data container, 1001=Service-level-AA container, 1010=Event notification, 1111=Multiple payloads

notes: The value 'Multiple payloads' is only used when the Payload container contents in figure 9.11.3.39.1 contains multiple payloads as shown in figure 9.11.3.39.2.
